from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

def run_python_file(path: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(path)],
        cwd=PROJECT_ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=10
    )
